snippet.title: World of Sea Battle. Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to World of Sea Battle!
Go from a simple sailor to a formidable sea wolf, join a guild or fight alone! An open game world that can accommodate thousands of players, fierce battles, politics and trade, dozens of types of ships, your own personal island and much more awaits you in the MMORPG World of Sea Battle!
World of Sea Battle, registration in the game and download: http://worldofseabattle.com/?f=yt
Discord: https://discord.gg/54p2UCgf
Subscribe to our channel and participate in the life of the game:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCsDAYnRa5cl0hSSf00e8hTQ?sub_confirmation=1
